campaign.limitation: Strategic AI played no Rostrum in the 48 unassisted games. Six targeted board scenarios prove every difficulty can play it and resolve its choices; six legally scripted quiet openings exercise it through full games. These are authored Irelia variants, not tournament registrations or strength evidence.
